footResolution.question: Main 2026-09-25: comb plate at U~16 would put riders through the live 2.25 ceiling (ends U 19.3-19.5).
footResolution.answer: The foot is NOT at U~16. The class-a lower-landing patch (U 15.47-16.06) is approach floor in front of the flap gates. Measured order along the up lane: gate cabinets U 16.63-18.42, end of the reconstructed granite floor / newel fronts at U 18.477 (up) and 18.649 (down), plates + 2 flat steps at y 0 to the lower working point U 20.18, incline after that. The live 1F ceiling (2.25) ends before the incline, so the clear height there stays 2.25 over flat steps; the a-failed void edge lies -0.39..-0.04 u before the working point, i.e. the 1F ceiling ends exactly where the steps start rising. The ceiling patch extent is consistent; nothing to change there.
